# Maximus Design System Platform

**Version:** 0.19.0 | **Status:** Pre-release · Phase 3 — Components

A governed, themeable, WCAG-compliant design system platform that generates consistent, accessible UIs for any government client engagement. Single Lit web component source. Multi-framework distribution packages.

All components are built to WCAG 2.1 AA (Section 508 for federal engagements; ADA Title II for state engagements).

---

## Package Architecture

| Package | Format | Target consumer |
|---|---|---|
| `@mms/components-react` | Generated React binding | React apps — DXHub and future React properties |
| `@mms/salesforce` | TBD | Salesforce (integration model TBD) |
| `@mms/aem-clientlib` | AEM client library | Adobe Experience Manager properties |
| `@mms/drupal-module` | Drupal module | Drupal properties |
| `@mms/headless-css` | CSS stylesheet + icon set | Any web platform that cannot consume web components |
| `@mms/tokens-structural` | CSS custom properties | All web platforms |
| `@mms/tokens-ios` | Swift values | iOS (tokens only) |
| `@mms/tokens-android` | Kotlin values | Android (tokens only) |
| `@mms/theme-default` | Brand token sheet | Neutral fallback for development and demos |
| `@mms/theme-[client]` | Brand token sheet | Per-engagement — one package per client brand |

> Packages are not yet published. Distribution begins after Phase 1 (token foundation) and Phase 3 (web component build) are complete.

---

## Technology Stack

- **Framework:** Lit (Web Components)
- **Language:** TypeScript
- **Documentation:** Storybook 10
- **Token Pipeline:** Style Dictionary
- **Design Tokens:** CSS Custom Properties
- **Prior Art:** Marina (Chubb Design System — Forrester-recognized)

---

## Architecture

### Token Model

Strict two-layer separation:

- **Layer 1 — Structural tokens** (`@mms/tokens-structural`) — Maximus-owned, fixed across all engagements. Spacing, neutral colors, utility colors, radius, elevation, motion, breakpoints, focus-ring, type scale structure.
- **Layer 2 — Brand token sheets** (`@mms/theme-[client]`) — Client-owned, standalone per engagement. Each brand sheet is a complete definition conforming to the structural contract — not an override layer.

### Distribution Model

One Lit web component core. Per-platform packages generated from that single source. Delivery teams install only their package — they never interact with the web component layer directly.

### Accessibility

WCAG compliance enforced structurally via token contracts, not manual review. Section 508 applies to federal engagements; ADA Title II applies to state engagements.
